name: Land shrimp
summary: Land shrimp sold at chợ Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên, 14 March 2016, calls it a specialty and the ingredient of Huế tôm chua. The market sells the shrimp. The plated dish is Huế’s. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Chợ Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên, 14 March 2016, names tôm đất caught in phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai.
howToEat: Buy the shrimp at the market. Thanh Niên does not print a cooking method for the raw shrimp.
The Huế plate made from it is tôm chua with boiled pork and pickled bean sprouts. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Cầu Hai, on National Highway 1A, facing the lagoon. Thanh Niên does not name a stall. A market hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Land shrimp at Cau Hai market
seoDescription: Tôm đất at chợ Cầu Hai is the shrimp Huế cooks as tôm chua. Thanh Niên names it and prints no recipe. A price is Check on arrival.
